executiveProfile.title: Executive Profile: The AI-First Architect
executiveProfile.hook: "Most AI never reaches production." I take systems from an empty repository to a running service — schema, queues, auth, tenant isolation, deployment, cost control — and I write the postmortem when they break.
executiveProfile.paragraph1: I am a Senior Software Engineer and Gen-AI Architect and an EU citizen (German passport), working from Berlin and open to teams anywhere in the EU. With a dual background in Applied Computer Science and Industrial Engineering from HTW Berlin & TU Berlin, I bridge technical delivery and the business case behind it.
executiveProfile.paragraph2: At Accenture Germany I build Spring Boot / Java microservices for Fortune 500 banking and automotive clients on OpenShift and Google Cloud. In parallel, under AI Waverider, I have designed, built and operated my own portfolio of production systems — multi-tenant SaaS on Next.js, Prisma/PostgreSQL and BullMQ, with RAG, vector search, multi-provider LLM routing, agentic pipelines and per-request cost accounting.
executiveProfile.paragraph3: What I bring: full end-to-end ownership — tenant isolation guarded by four independent mechanisms, an 8-language localisation system with a build-failing completeness gate, and GDPR right-to-erasure implemented as a tested user journey. I work in English day to day, and add German C1 and native Arabic where a team needs the reach.
executiveProfile.whyDubai: What I'm looking for: a senior engineering, architecture or tech-lead role with an EU-based team — remote-first or hybrid — that is putting Gen-AI into real products. No visa, no sponsorship, no relocation paperwork: a German passport means I can start anywhere in the EU/EEA.

summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.paragraph1: German citizen and Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years in enterprise development, specializing in microservices, cloud technologies, and AI integration. Educated at Germany's top universities (TU Berlin, HTW Berlin) with proven track record delivering for Fortune 500 finance and automotive clients.
summary.paragraph2: Known for end-to-end ownership. Designed, built and operated 23 self-authored production systems alongside full-time enterprise delivery. Coordinated offshore teams across 3 time zones. Founder, CEO & CTO of AI Waverider, a storefront publishing a curated library of 5,600+ n8n automation workflows.
summary.paragraph3: Unique value: an EU citizen who ships regulated, production software — GDPR erasure as a tested journey, 8-language localisation with a build-failing gate, and per-request AI cost accounting. Trilingual (German C1, English C1, Arabic native).
